{"dialogue": "Leo: okay my kitchen is finally not a health hazard
Leo: sink ecosystem officially cleared
Maya: no way
Maya: proud of you honestly
Me: wait you actually did dishes??
Leo: i know, growth
Leo: took like 20 mins too, i put that sketch on in the background
Maya: never go back to workkkk
Me: lol it's still stuck in my head
Me: i heard someone say it at work today and lost it
Leo: see it's cultural now
Maya: ugh speaking of work
Maya: can i ask a favor for tomorrow?
Me: yeah what's up
Maya: my appointment tomorrow morning is running long
Maya: can we push pizza to 1 instead of noon?
Leo: oh yeah 1 works for me
Me: yeah 1's good for me too
Maya: thank god, i was stressing about making my 1:30 thing but that got moved too
Leo: nice, so no rush then?
Maya: no, i can actually eat like a person now
Me: perfect, still Mario's right?
Leo: yeah still good for me
Maya: yes please, i need those garlic knots
Me: same, i've been thinking about them since monday
Leo: lol same, crying suit guy would approve
Maya: pizza in his honor
Me: did you guys eat yet?
Leo: just made soup actually
Maya: grandma gang
Leo: hey your soup and toast influence got to me
Me: i had pasta again, i'm in leo's leftover loop now
Maya: what kind?
Me: just jar sauce and parmesan, lazy version
Leo: solid
Leo: my soup is from a can don't get excited
Maya: no judgment, i might do toast after this
Me: it's freezing again tonight huh
Maya: yes i broke out the heavy jacket again this morning
Leo: same, fall jacket is just my uniform now
Me: same, wore mine home and i'm still cold
Maya: okay tea time, need to warm up
Leo: get me the weird lemon one virtually
Me: chamomile for me please
Maya: one weird one for leo, chamomile for you, got it
Leo: she remembers
Me: how's your laptop doing btw? still dying?
Maya: ugh yes, it froze twice this afternoon
Leo: did you do the sacred restart ritual?
Maya: three times lol
Me: IT ever reply to you?
Maya: nope, i'm ghosted
Leo: classic
Leo: mine was dragging too so i just logged off early
Maya: good for you
Me: i actually left on time today for once
Maya: two weeks in a row?? who are you
Me: i know, i'm scared too
Leo: don't jinx it before tomorrow
Me: lol true
Maya: how sore are you guys from monday? i'm still feeling leg day
Leo: i'm good, i skipped like a coward
Me: my legs were dead tuesday but better now
Maya: lucky, stairs still hurt
Leo: are we still doing that cooking game tonight or tomorrow?
Maya: i can't tonight, i'm gonna crash early
Me: i could do one round tomorrow after pizza?
Leo: yeah tomorrow night works, no pressure tho
Maya: i might join if i'm not sore, no promises i won't burn stuff
Leo: two fires max, house rule
Maya: rude but accurate
Me: lol
Me: so tomorrow at 1 then?
Maya: yes! thank you guys again
Leo: of course, see you out front?
Maya: yep, i'll bus over after my appointment
Me: i'll walk over, it's like 10 mins
Leo: i'll circle for parking like last time lol
Maya: good luck soldier
Me: text when you're close?
Maya: will do
Leo: bet, can't wait
Maya: me too, i need it after this week", "writer_note": "Kept the voices consistent with tea orders, soup weather, and running jokes, then slipped the time change in as a single-detail update with short acceptances and a quick check that Mario's was still the spot."}
